current.text: Champagnie signed a 3-year, 45 million deal with the Spurs.
Projected Spurs starters are Fox, Castle, Vassell, Harris and Wembanyama. Champagnie is not among them.
The Spurs signed Tobias Harris to replace Harrison Barnes. Harris is the likely starter at forward and has a calf strain.
The Spurs' starting lineup is not set. Harper, Fox, Castle and the forward spot are all in the mix.
Experts expect more three-guard lineups, and Dylan Harper may start next to Castle and Fox. That leaves fewer forward minutes.
The roster is very deep at forward, and experts cannot see where his minutes come from with Harris, Harper and Vassell around. They advise against reaching for him.
He is not a must-draft unless a couple of injuries open minutes ahead of him.
His rim finishing of 71% last season is unusually high for a perimeter player. The expert does not expect it to hold.
The Spurs are expected to consolidate their forward depth through trades in the near future, but not right away.
One expert predicts 63 wins for the Spurs, and they could take the top seed in the West.

durable.text: He is an undersized four, so teams with frontcourt size can hurt him on the glass.
His fantasy value comes from threes, FT% and few turnovers. He adds little in points, assists and steals, and his FG% is below average.
